title: Workflow step fails with 403 'Resource not accessible by integration' when commenting, labeling, or releasing
symptoms: HttpError: Resource not accessible by integration
403 from gh pr comment, gh release create, or actions/github-script
The same workflow works in an older repository
cause: New personal repositories, and repositories in organizations with the restricted default, give GITHUB_TOKEN read only access to contents and packages. Write calls need the permission granted in the workflow or the repo setting.
fix: Grant the exact write scopes in a permissions block on the job.
apply:
permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write
affected: GitHub repositories using the restricted Workflow permissions default (personal repos and many org repos), as of October 2026
